import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int N, M, P;
    static int[] num = new int[503];
    static int[] V = new int[503];
    static int[][] C = new int[503][503];
    static long[][] dp = new long[503][503];
    static long[][] ans = new long[503][503];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();

        // Compute binomial coefficients C[i][j]
        for (int i = 0; i <= M; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;
            }
        }

        // Initialize num and V arrays
        for (int i = 0; i <= M; i++) {
            num[i] = 0;
            V[i] = 0;
        }
        num[0] = 1;

        // Calculate num and V arrays
        for (int i = 1; i <= M; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                long temp1 = ((long) num[j - 1] * num[i - j]) % P;
                temp1 = (temp1 * (i + 1)) % P;
                temp1 = (temp1 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;
                num[i] = (int) ((num[i] + temp1) % P);

                int sum = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= i; k++) {
                    sum += Math.abs(j - k);
                }

                long term1 = ((long) V[j - 1] * num[i - j]) % P;
                term1 = (term1 * (i + 1)) % P;
                term1 = (term1 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;

                long term2 = ((long) V[i - j] * num[j - 1]) % P;
                term2 = (term2 * (i + 1)) % P;
                term2 = (term2 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;

                long term3 = ((long) num[i - j] * num[j - 1]) % P;
                term3 = (term3 * sum) % P;
                term3 = (term3 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;

                V[i] = (int) ((V[i] + term1 + term2 + term3) % P);
            }
        }

        // Initialize dp and ans arrays
        for (int i = 0; i <= N + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= M; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = 0;
                ans[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = 1;

        // Dynamic programming to compute ans
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k + i + 1 <= N + 1 && k + j <= M; k++) {
                    int ni = i + k + 1;
                    int nj = j + k;
                    long val = ((dp[i][j] * C[M - j][k]) % P * num[k]) % P;
                    dp[ni][nj] = (dp[ni][nj] + val) % P;

                    long add_ans = ((ans[i][j] * C[M - j][k]) % P * num[k]) % P
                            + ((dp[i][j] * C[M - j][k]) % P * V[k]) % P;
                    ans[ni][nj] = (ans[ni][nj] + add_ans) % P;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans[N + 1][M]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
